crossRefs.note: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if…
but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come…
But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

translations.web: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.
translations.bsb: Then Abimelech and the companies with him rushed forward and took their stand at the entrance of the city gate. The other two companies rushed against all who were in the fields and struck them down.
translations.kjv: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew
translations.asv: And Abimelech, and the companies that were with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city: and the two companies rushed upon all that were in the field, and smote them.
